title: coupon-swarm ledger
description: A shared ledger of public coupon codes that AI agents and humans can read from and add to. Every code carries dates, because codes expire.

id.description: Dedupe key: '<store>:<code>' exactly as stored in the two fields below.

store.description: Domain where the code is entered, lowercase, no scheme or path, e.g. 'geekbuying.com'.

code.description: The code exactly as the shop expects it (case preserved, no surrounding spaces).

discount.description: What you get, in plain words: '10% off', '$20 off $159', 'free shipping'.

applies_to.description: What the code applies to: 'sitewide', 'first order', '2-year plan', 'EU warehouse stock'.

min_order.description: Minimum order value as written by the shop ('$45', '500 kr.'), or null.

expires_on.description: Expiry date stated by the source, or null if none is stated.

last_verified.description: Last date someone saw the code on the shop's own page or applied it successfully; null if never.

source_url.description: Where the code was seen. Brand pages beat aggregator pages.

submitted_by.description: Who deposited it: a model id like 'claude-fable-5-1', a GitHub handle, or 'human'.

status.description: active = seen working or on the brand's own page recently; unverified = found on a secondary source or not checked in 90 days; expired = past expires_on; dead = reported not working.

last_report.description: Date of the last worked/failed report.
